mapper.select: SELECT task.id_ FROM tcomm_task task LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity oppo ON task.info_id = oppo.id_ WHERE

SELECT oppo.opp_code AS oppCode, oppo.opp_name AS oppName, IFNULL(area.name_, '') AS areaName, IFNULL(oppo.cust_manager_name, '') AS custManageName, IFNULL(oppo.cust_manager_tel, '') AS custManageTel, IFNULL(designer.name_ch, '') AS designerName, IFNULL(designer.name_, '') AS designerTel, IFNULL(designerArea.name_, '') AS designerArea, IFNULL(sc.name_, task.task_code) AS taskCode, DATE_FORMAT(task.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(task.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS auditTime, task.score_ AS score FROM tcomm_task task LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity oppo ON task.info_id = oppo.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON oppo.opp_area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_user designer ON oppo.designer = designer.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_org org ON designer.org_id = org.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area designerArea ON org.area_id = designerArea.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_code sc ON sc.code_ = task.task_code AND sc.type_ = 'cust_manager_order' WHERE
ORDER BY oppo.opp_code, task.create_time DESC
